claims: As of April 2026, John Ternus has an estimated net worth of approximately $75 million to $100 million.
John Ternus is the incoming CEO of Apple.
John Ternus built his fortune over a two-decade career at Apple.
John Ternus's fortune was primarily built through salary, bonuses, and substantial stock-based compensation (RSUs) as Senior Vice President of Hardware Engineering.
John Ternus became VP of Hardware Engineering in 2013.
John Ternus became Senior Vice President of Hardware Engineering.
John Ternus's base salary as SVP was estimated around $1 million.
John Ternus's total compensation, including stock awards, often exceeded $20 million per year.
John Ternus takes over as CEO on September 1, 2026.
Tim Cook is the outgoing CEO of Apple.
Tim Cook has an estimated fortune of $2.9 billion to $3 billion.
Tim Cook accumulated his fortune over a longer period than John Ternus.
